Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Of Home
Counsel for Applicant :- Chandan Srivastava,Lavkush Yadav,Rajneesh Kumar Singh,Yogesh So
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.0170 of 2024 under sections 376, 328, 506 IPC, P.S. Kotwali Ayodhya, District Ayodhya.

3. In terms of the FIR registered on 02.04.2024, it was alleged that on 02.08.2020 when the informant had gone to meet her friend, the applicant gave her tea and after consuming the tea, she became unconscious and thereafter she was shown that wrong was committed on her.
In the statement under section 161, the victim reiterated the FIR version.

sentences.text: 4. The counsel for the applicant argues that the victim is aged about 25 years and the FIR has been lodged after about three and half years.

5. Considering the inordinately delay in lodging the FIR and considering the age of the victim, a case for bail is made out more so when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 04.04.2024.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Anil Singh @ Anil Kumar Singh be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/-
(Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 VNP/-
